title: FORGE-YM continuum mass-gap falsification protocol
central_hypothesis: There exists a gauge-equivariant coarse-graining and scale assignment for which FORGE-YM finite measures converge to a nontrivial four-dimensional Osterwalder-Schrader Yang-Mills theory with a finite strictly positive physical mass gap.

rejection_criteria.criterion: A reproducible negative eigenvalue of an Osterwalder-Schrader Gram matrix persists beyond certified numerical error, or an analytic counterexample is found.
Controlled finite-size and cutoff extrapolations prefer m_G=0 and m_n tends to zero.
The renormalized physical mass m_n diverges as a_n tends to zero.
No coupling/coarse-graining flow matches the preregistered independent gauge-invariant observables with residuals tending to zero.
Independent spectral, metric, walk, and causal diagnostics fail to approach a common four-dimensional universality class.
All connected higher correlators vanish in the proposed limit or the renormalized interaction tends to zero.
Dimensionless mass, string-tension, or susceptibility ratios retain nonvanishing dependence on seed, update ordering, or admissible microscopic rule variants.

minimum_reporting: All parameter scans, failed runs, and seeds
At least three independent scale-setting observables
Competing zero-gap, finite-gap, and divergent-gap extrapolation models
Independent code or precision replication for any positivity violation
